# mapPaintBox

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

The axis-aligned box containing the four mapped corners of a box.

A rotated or sheared transform turns a rectangle into a parallelogram, so the containing box is what a `/BBox` needs.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
mapPaintBox(transform: PaintTransform, box: readonly [number, number, number, number]): [number, number, number, number]
```
